verdict.rationale: Docs mention multi-document querying/comparison in the QnA feature and OCR can be called repeatedly via API for many files, but there is no documented batch/bulk-upload endpoint, and real-world use shows scaling limits (a 900-page single request timed out and had to be chunked), while other users report successful large-scale digitization of forms with human-review overhead. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch processing API or endpoint, documented rate/size limits for large jobs, and independent evidence of reliable bulk throughput at scale.
